featured_reviews.review_text:
We love Parsi food and when we get it delivered at home, we love it more. I ordered a dhansak which was very well balanced dish and came with brown rice and salad. Brown rice was perfect and long. The dhansak was flavourful. I also ordered the Chicken Farcha which was a bit oily but it was yummy. The Lagan nu Custard was delivered frozen cold maintaining it's texture and temperature and tasted the best out of all the dishes. Also tried their chicken croissant🥐 which was soft and the filling was pretty decent.
Must try for Parsi food Lovers. Homely feeling in the taste

featured_reviews.name: Rustom Irani
featured_reviews.review_text:
There's food which comforts and food that helps you escape by triggering the taste buds of memory or location. Very rarely do you get to experience food that does both.
'Cheron' have kept a small yet bright flicker of Parsi food alive amidst a whole bunch of new agey franchisee places.
The chutney is the stuff of legend. It's what makes every amazing Patra ni Machhi you have tried a food of the gods. And if you haven't tried this chutney in its other avatars in a patty or as a sandwich you have denied yourself a pleasured palate.
I'm a big kebabs and appetizer meats guy, so immediately took a liking to the delicately spiced chicken cheese balls and the smokey melt-in-your-mouth tikkas.
The chicken mince balls were a big sense and slightly spicidr so i suggest have them piping hit as juices might dry up of you pack then too long.
The kheema patty's/chops are mini meals in themselves so less is more is a great idea.
Overall though for the price and the taste alone make them a regular snacking option if not a complete Sunday meal with the family.
Go ahead prepare to escape in food heaven.

It's is place where you'll get Quantity as well as Quality.

featured_reviews.name: Jagdish Waghela
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 for Gujarat Pickles! 🥭🌶️✨

Honestly, Gujarat pickles are not just pickles — they are pure emotion in a jar ❤️🥒 From sweet mango pickle to spicy chili achar, every bite feels like a perfect mix of tradition, taste, and reality 😍🔥
The best part is the balance of flavors — sweet, spicy, tangy, and sometimes a little bold surprise 😋💥 Unlike many regular pickles, Gujarati pickles have their own royal identity 👑 They remind you of home, family lunches, and those old-school kitchen memories 🍛🏡
Reality check? ✔️

Some brands claim “homemade taste,” but only a few truly give that authentic grandma-style flavor 👵🥭 The real Gujarati pickle should have rich oil, strong masala aroma, and that unforgettable taste that stays in your mind 🤤✨

Especially mango pickle and chhundo are next-level legends 🥭💛 One spoon with simple dal-rice and suddenly the whole meal becomes 10x better 🍚🔥

Once you start eating, stopping is impossible 😭🥭🌶️

featured_reviews.name: Sonal Waghela
featured_reviews.review_text:
Along nice beautiful rating on Gujarat pickles rwrite with emojii

Gujarat pickles — honestly, they’re not just food, they’re a whole emotion on the plate 😍✨

From the very first bite, you get that perfect explosion of flavors — tangy, spicy, slightly sweet, and deeply aromatic 🌶️🍋🥭. Gujarati pickles have this unique balance that not every region achieves. Whether it’s the classic mango (keri) pickle, the bold chhundo (sweet grated mango), or the spicy gorkeri, each one feels crafted with care and tradition 💛

The oil glistens beautifully, carrying rich spices like mustard seeds, fenugreek, turmeric, and red chili — creating a fragrance that hits you even before you taste it 🤤🌿. And that taste? It lingers… making even a simple roti or dal-chawal feel like a feast 🍛✨

What makes Gujarat pickles extra special is their perfect sweet-spicy twist — not too harsh, not too mild, just beautifully balanced 👌💫. They feel homely, nostalgic, and comforting — like something made with love in a traditional kitchen 🏡💖

Texture-wise, they’re amazing too — soft yet slightly crunchy pieces, coated generously in masala that sticks perfectly to every bite 😋

Overall rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)
✔ Flavor: 10/10
✔ Aroma: 10/10
✔ Authenticity: 10/10
✔ Happiness level: Unlimited 😄💃

If you love pickles, Gujarat ones are truly a must-try — they turn ordinary meals into something unforgettable 🌈🍽️

featured_reviews.name: Dwayne Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
Decided to order from David Caterers at Vakola for the September Feast. Turned out to be a total disaster. We had ordered 0.5 kg Fish fingers, 12 Doz Mutton Shammi Kebabs, 0.5 kg Chicken 65 and 1 kilo of Chicken Korma Gravy.
1. The Fish fingers upon arrival were all different in size and the box felt very light, so we decided to weigh the entire box including the tartar sauce (Never done this in my life, but had to considering the weight). It amounted to 360 odd grams. The owner says we don't know how to cook and no idea about weight, he says the weight before cooking basa is 500gms then after cooking becomes less. Don't know how he didn't account for the batter and oil he infused with his small fingers🤷‍♂️
2. The shammi kebabs were priced at ruppees 40 a piece, which is daylight robbery. It was really tiny in size and had whole spices plus lots of Dal bits. Couldn't taste the mutton at all🤷‍♂️
3. The chicken 65 was overall very salty and wasn't appetizing at all.
4. The chicken korma was the only saving grace, but after such horror full experience, there is nothing left to rave about it.
But if the above wasn't bad enough, the whole experience got worse with the way Mr. Vincent Soares took the feedback.
Utterly rude and starts siding with his cooks. Randomly gets angry and blames it on us saying I gave 3kgs of chicken (which I did weigh btw and amounted to 1.8kgs, FYI the chicken must have weighed hardly a kilo but with the gravy amounted to 1.8kgs)

I suggest Mr. Vincent goes to Bandra (preferably the Family table) and sees what all you can get for 40 ruppees instead of those measly kebabs he sent us.

Highly recommend to skip and avoid ordering from here. Owner and the food both are highly distasteful.

featured_reviews.review_text: This is the third time after the many many many orders i have placed in the past via Swiggy to Bismillah caterers. This has been consistent in my last 3-4 orders now with them via Swiggy and sorry but i won't be placing any more orders with these guys. Day by day they're getting pathetic than ever, unlike back in the past where there wasn't a complain after ordering via them. The taste, masala, quantity also, plus meat pieces met the price expectations of the customer but today they're stopped so low in compromising with the relationship of their long standing loyal customers who have been placing orders with them from over the years. The quantity has decreased so much, they're packing just coloured boiled rice in the plastic container but 2 pieces of meat that too more of bones, there's no taste due to absence of biryani masala n so much cheating.
